d:
The "cost" of raising a child can hardly be a deciding factor for any parent, because the experience and the memories you make all along are priceless!
With this video we aim to help you get a perspective on how you can manage your finances well around this beautiful experience of your life. Because a well planned and financially secure future can not only improve this journey but also give you peace of mind because you feel prepared for the life you want with your child!
India’s fertility rate has dropped below replacement levels for the first time.
